groups.title: Baseline and delivery setup
groups.reason: Keep platform/toolchain and distribution proof separate from feature implementation.

groups.title: Design system, navigation and interaction shell
groups.reason: The shell uses the same components, focus behavior, dialogs and responsive rules; build and review them together.

groups.title: Local accounts, validation and safe persistence
groups.reason: Keep storage and compatibility as an early gate; settings will expose its file operations in phase 09.

groups.title: Sellable products and inventory
groups.reason: Keep stock history, reversals and historical quantity checks together as one complete inventory feature.

groups.title: Cash sales, saved receipt, drafts and held orders
groups.reason: Draft recovery and hold/resume are part of the same ticket lifecycle as checkout; separating them created a partially finished sales flow.

groups.title: Sales history, returns and voids
groups.reason: Keep return/void accounting and historical stock checks as a distinct verification gate after checkout.

groups.title: Daily accounting, expense categories and cashbox
groups.reason: Categories feed expense entry, and daily/cash funding and transfers change both ledgers; implement and verify them together.

groups.title: Suppliers, debts, materials and prices
groups.reason: Supplier and material setup are the reference data used by the same purchase workflow.

groups.title: Purchase invoices, analysis and supplier payments
groups.reason: Immediate payment already belongs to invoice entry; combining them removes a later-phase dependency from a core purchase action.

groups.title: Settings, backups, import and recovery
groups.reason: Keep the complete settings and user-facing recovery review after operational records are available; reuse phase 02 storage services.

groups.title: Statements, day review, PDF reports and printing
groups.reason: Statements/day review and their reports share filters, financial meanings and export actions; verify screen-to-document parity together.

groups.title: Complete MVP verification, migration rehearsal and release
groups.reason: Keep independent end-to-end, installed-device and cutover verification as the final gate.
